title: daily-scratchpad-gpu-ops-14
content:
Daily scratchpad - GPU ops / capacity / networking
Date: 2026-03-04
Owner: Jordan Lee

TODAY (high priority)
- [ ] Fix flaky pod eviction on ded1 (seen 2x during canary load tests). logs: /var/log/pods/evict-ded1.log -> OOMKill? check kube events.
- [ ] Increase reserved capacity for Dedicated pool 'dedicated-gpu-a' by 10% for March 8-12 spike (sales demo). Need approval from finance (cc Maya).
- [ ] Follow up with networking on mtls cert rotation schedule for onprem v2 nodes (Diego owns action). Impact: private deployments may fail healthchecks after 03/10 if not rotated.

TODAY (quick ops tasks)
- [ ] Re-run nightly perf job for q8 quantized models (job: infra/perf/q8-nightly). Capture tail latency p99.
- [ ] Add alert: GPU memory fragmentation > 70% -> ticket to SRE (INFRA-4123).
- [ ] Patch node-allocator to skip nodes with 'maintenance=true' label (hotfix PR ready).

NOTES / OBSERVATIONS
- Observed spike in small-token (<16) short requests around 08:00 PST - likely burst from partner integration test. Suggest: enable prefix caching for partner-xyz route.
- KV cache hit rate for redwood/llama-2-13b-q8: 62% last 24h (down from 78%). Investigate: are clients using session-ids correctly? link to trace: https://github.com/redwood-inference/traces/trace-2031
- ded1 eviction seems correlated with aggressive autoscaler settings (scaleDownUtilization set to 0.1). Consider bump to 0.25 for this pool.

MEETINGS / FOLLOW-UPS
- 10:30am: sync with Maya (capacity planning) - bring projected committed hours chart and cost delta for +10% reserved.
- 3:00pm: runbook review with SRE (onprem cert rotation). Update runbook section 'tls-rotation' if steps changed.
- Post-mortem: schedule 30m next week for the kube OOM events if we hit 3+ occurrences.

COMMANDS / QUICK REFS
- kubectl -n infra describe pod <evicted-pod> --show-events
- jq filter to get GPU mem: jq '.containers[] | select(.name=="inference") | .resources' pods.json
- perf job: ./scripts/run_perf.sh --model redwood/llama-2-13b-q8 --batch-sizes 1,4,8 --duration 600

PENDING PRS / DEPLOYMENTS
- PR #256 (node-allocator hotfix) - needs one more approval (Maya) -> target merge EOD today.
- infra/kv-cache: canary rollout scheduled 2026-03-06 -> ensure fallback policy enabled.

RISKS / BLOCKERS
- Certificate rotation window conflicts with customer private deployments that have manual firewall windows. Need to coordinate with Sales/Customer Success.
- If KV cache hit doesn't recover, token costs could increase ~12% for dedicated workloads; prepare rollback plan for q8 quantization changes.

TODO (personal)
- [ ] Draft short blurb for oncall handover: what to look for re: gpu fragmentation + eviction.
- [ ] Add note to console dashboard: 'kv-cache hit rate' chart on model page (quick nav).
- [ ] Email finance re: reserved capacity bump estimate (attach projected invoice delta).

RANDOM NOTES / TODOs (non-blocking)
- Check new CI images for cuda 12.3 compatibility next week.
- Ask research if they can schedule retraining of smaller prompt sets to reduce prefix length variance.

END
